## What to build

The Python toolchain's interpreter is a Nix store path, not `python3` resolved from PATH, so a toolchain bump changes the result key (hazards P1 and P3, spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] python_test targets run under the store-path interpreter whatever the host PATH
- [ ] Host and user site-packages are not visible to tests

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
title: Python toolchain uses a store-path interpreter
